svg.title: Same input · normalized KD-force concentration
svg.desc: One fixed median-deviation image (CIFAR-100 bowl); darker color means more local force after whole-map unit normalization.
svg.text: One fixed median-deviation image (CIFAR-100 bowl); darker color means more local force after whole-map unit normalization.
All three maps use the same unit-force normalization and color-depth scale. This draft shows spatial concentration, not signed direction.
